The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''26,012 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,441 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. The [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of [[Stav Kesh]], a temple of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was [[Vor'Dana]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
